notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds column); it rolls fund balance (278,189 -> 300,638), so beginning_cash is null (no beginning cash printed) and ending_cash is the p3 cash lines (all assets are cash). Identity: 278,189 + 382,297 - 359,848 = 300,638. Statement 'Taxes: Property' 137,881 split (as in FY2023) using the fund schedules' rows, which add up exactly: General p9 (property tax 102,220, pro rate 257, carline 166, homestead 5,340, property tax credit 6,950, motor vehicle tax 11,462 = 126,395) + Street p11 (property tax 10,218, homestead 570, property tax credit 698 = 11,486). Statement p4 prints Streets 35,552 (Special Revenue Fund) and Park 78,782 (General Fund), consistent with the departmental schedules; the Statement of Activities (p2) and budget schedule (p8) label 78,782 as street/public works and 35,552 as culture and recreation; p4 labels used. Business-type: Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6), single 'Proprietary Fund' column; measure cash (modified cash net position = cash in bank 542,627 + certificates of deposit 160,297, p5); no single receipts total on p6 (operating 731,783 + insurance 24 + miscellaneous 11,025), so the printed Total Receipts 742,832 of the proprietary schedule (p13) is used; disbursements 756,001 printed on p2/p8/p14. 716,093 + 742,832 - 756,001 = 702,924. No transfers (p4 Transfers '-'). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3; totals equal the government-wide 300,638), business-type lines from p1. Detail: departmental schedules for General Fund (department columns General/Fire/Park), Street Fund and proprietary funds (per fund column); Debt Service Fund schedule (p12) and Utility Deposit column have only zero/blank lines and are not recorded. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule (pp7-8) covers the same funds at function level and is not recorded (no double counting). Zero cells skipped. Read pages 1-14 of 14
